name: Fast Deterministic GPU Voxelization (Sort-Scatter)
aliases: parallel sort + unique + scatter PyTorch path
definition: A deterministic GPU voxelization method for BEVFusion training that replaces a slow O(N^2) C++/CUDA implementation with a parallel PyTorch-based approach using stable sorting and scattering, achieving ~100x speedup while maintaining bit-identical output.
summary: Fast Deterministic GPU Voxelization is a PyTorch method that converts 3D point clouds to voxel grids with bit-identical reproducibility via stable sorting, unlike standard atomic operations.
